bias.note: shadowOrigin = worldPos.xy + traceN*normalOffset + dir*dirOffset. Prevents self-shadowing acne

traceNormal.note: If N.xy length < threshold, traceN = (0,0,1) else dominant axis

sun.note: Multiplier when sun ray hits wall: final *= shadowFactor (0.25 = 75% dark). maxDist caps DDA steps

point.note: Point light shadow: traceRay(dist - epsilon). factor 0.15 = stronger shadow than sun

dda.note: Max DDA iterations for wall hit and shadow trace
